text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: My pudding... My pudding is goooone~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...It is due to this officer's sheer 
incompetence. To think I couldn't even 
track down the culprit...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hey, everyone! Why does everybody 
look so down in the dumps...? What 
happened?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan! Mmm, well, truth is... 
Biko-chan's pudding went missing!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I bought some pudding an hour ago and left 
it right here... I was talking with 
Big-senpai the whole time, but—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! My pudding... Someone ate my 
pudding!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I only took my eyes off it for a second! 
And yet, there was just an empty cup left 
sitting there!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Having been called upon to utilize this 
officer's keen nose, I took up the case to 
bring it to justice. However—

text_block_list.name: Glasses-Wearing Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
"A horse girl eating pudding? Sorry... I 
don't think I saw anyone like that."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It pains me to admit it... but at this 
rate, there is a strong possibility this 
case will go cold.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, guys! Don't worry, just wait right 
here!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry...? Wait, could it be! Did you 
figure something out, Urara-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Look everyone, case solved!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I went and bought a whoooole bunch! 
Pudding!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Huh... pudding...? How exactly does that 
solve the case...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well, the whole reason everyone's sad is 
because you didn't get to eat any pudding, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Someone ate it without asking, making you 
feel down and super sad! And then everyone 
was groaning and frowning!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So... let's all eat pudding together! If 
we eat lots and lots, everyone's gonna be 
smiling!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Urara-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...You're right! Moping around forever 
isn't heroic at all! Let's dig in 
together!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! —Wait, look... It's Windy-san!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-What's the big idea! What are you 
guys doing out here, nodon?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
We should be asking you, Windy-chan! This 
is the Ritto dorm, what brings you here?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy just came by to return a DVD to 
Biko, nodon. ...Wait, Urara. Is that 
pudding?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup! You should have some too, Windy-san! 
We've got sooooo much of it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Nah, Windy's gonna pass, nodon. I just 
ate some a little while ago, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Pudding? Wait a second, does that 
mean—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Gasp?! Oops...!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Could you be the perpetrator behind the 
pudding theft?! Suspect apprehendeeeeeed!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way to the convenience store, I 
heard the lively voices of horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat?! That was milk pudding?! The 
packaging didn't say anything obvious 
about it, so I had no idea...!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Biko-chan doesn't do well with milk, after 
all. If you'd eaten it by mistake, you 
would've been so disappointed...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai... Did you eat it for me 
because you knew?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
N-No way!! Windy only ate it 'cause I'm a 
bad girl, nodon!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Whatever the true motives were, thanks 
to Urara-san, the incident was peacefully 
resolved. You acted just like a great 
detective!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Urara is a great detective?! Whoaaa... 
That sounds so cool!
